Titan Grenades — Ben_'s build

Fire Crossbow Grenades  •  Warrior → Titan  •  Path of Exile 2 (patch 0.5)

A Warrior who throws grenades and rolls to detonate them. Level Acts 1–2 as a mace Slammer, then respec to a Crossbow and rain Explosive / Cluster / Flash grenades — 80% of their Physical converts to Fire. The Titan Hulking Form supercharges a tree full of small grenade / area passives. This guide is a direct conversion of Ben_'s Mobalytics build — his exact passive tree, ascendancy and gem loadout — with average rare gear on his item bases, all verified inside this repository's Path of Building 2 engine. Source: Ben_ · Titan Grenades.

Full skill loadout

Explosive Grenade5-link
Main boss skill. Bouncing grenade, 80% Physical→Fire. Multishot II · Elemental Armament II · Magnified Area II · Fire Penetration II · Fire Attunement. Throw, roll-cancel, detonate.
Cluster Grenade5-link
Clear. Scatters mini-grenades. Multishot II · Short Fuse · Magnified Area II · Deliberation · Heft.
Flash Grenade5-link
Armour break + stun. Multishot II · Armour Break III · Heft · Deliberation · Brutality III — breaks the boss's armour so it takes more damage.
Freezing MarkLv 7
A vessel for Mark for Death II (marked enemy takes much more damage) + Mark of Siphoning II · Prolonged Duration II · Arcane Tempo II.
Stormcaller Arrowswap
On a Bow + Quiver weapon-swap: Conduction · Overcharge · Commiserate · Elemental Armament II · Lightning Penetration — apply a 60%+ Shock, then swap back to the crossbow.
Crossbow Shot5-link
Filler crossbow attack (Admixture · Martial Tempo · Ammo Conservation · Blind · Break Posture) for reloading ammo and applying Blind/Daze.
Eternal Rage (Spirit)Spirit
Keeps Rage permanently maxed — a constant 'more' attack-damage / speed multiplier.
War Banner (Spirit)Spirit
Planted banner: a damage / Presence aura (Magnified Area · Daresso's Passion).
Scavenged Plating (Spirit)Spirit
Stacking Armour buff — the main scaling defensive layer.

Ascendancy — Titan (8 points, Ben_'s picks)

1

Hulking Form

50% increased effect of Small Passive Skills. The build stacks dozens of small grenade / area / fire / Strength passives — this multiplies them all. The signature Titan node for Grenades.

→
2

Crushing Impacts

25% more Damage against Heavy-Stunned enemies and your hits become Crushing Blows — grenades stun hard, so this is near-permanent on bosses.

→
3

Mysterious Lineage

15% more maximum Life. A flat multiplier on your whole Life pool — pure effective-HP.

→
4

Colossal Capacity

Carry a Chest with +20 inventory slots. Ben_'s SSF / quality-of-life pick — far more loot per map; swap it for Stone Skin (50% more body Armour) if you want pure defence.

Why Titan? Hulking Form turns this build's pile of small grenade / area / fire / Strength passives into a giant multiplier; Mysterious Lineage (15% more Life) + a wall of Armour rares make a tanky bruiser, and Crushing Impacts rewards the constant stun grenades apply. Ben_'s 4th notable is Colossal Capacity (an SSF loot/QoL pick) — take Stone Skin instead for 50% more body-armour Armour if you want pure defence.

Passive tree (Ben_'s tree, ~level 80)

103 main passives + 8 Titan ascendancy points — Ben_'s exact allocation, mapped node-for-node from his Mobalytics export to this engine's tree (gold = allocated, purple = his three jewel sockets). The campaign-complete tree; it keeps growing toward level 95. Tree version 0_4.

How the damage is counted

Explosive Grenade is a cooldown skill with stored uses: you fire a volley, roll to cancel the wind-up, and the grenades detonate after their fuse. The headline is the engine's own FullDPS for one grenade's hit × the sustained throw rate — it does not multiply by the extra grenades from Multishot, so against a boss (where several grenades overlap point-blank) real damage is meaningfully higher. Flash Grenade's Armour Break, Freezing Mark's Mark for Death, the weapon-swap Shock, and the Titan Crushing Impacts stun multiplier are all active in the figure.
Hit DPS, one grenade (engine)8,977
+ Ignite (fire damage-over-time)1,551
Full DPS, one grenade10,528
× grenades overlapping a boss (up to 4)up to ~42k

Enemy state: Pinnacle boss, Armour Broken, Shocked, Ignited, Rage active. Throw rate is 0.24/s (a cooldown skill with stored uses). Multishot grenades that overlap a boss point-blank are not auto-summed by the calculator, so sustained boss DPS in play is higher than the single-grenade Full DPS shown.

Defensive model. An Armour + Life Titan: high-Armour rares on every slot, Scavenged Plating (stacking Armour buff), Mysterious Lineage (15% more Life), permanent Rage and the tree's slow-mitigation nodes. With only average gear at level 80 the Life pool is modest (~2.6k); it climbs a lot toward level 95 with more Life nodes and better rolls. Physical and Chaos are the soft spots — add Stone Skin and an Endurance-charge layer to harden.

Levels 1 – 12 — Act 1 — Mace Slammer start

Warrior begins with maces, so you level Act 1 as a melee Slammer to use the Strength start nodes. Lead with Mace Strike into Rolling Slam; this is the build's rough patch (“struggles a bit with maces in Act 1”). Grab every Life / Resistance rare you see and start banking gold — the crossbow respec later costs about 7,000 gold.

Ascendancy this stage: None yet

Gear priorities

SlotItemWhy
WeaponAny two-handed Mace with high % Physical + flat PhysicalCarries Mace Strike / Rolling Slam through Act 1; you'll drop it at the crossbow swap.
ArmourStrength (Armour) bases with +Life and ResistancesPure survivability; Strength also feeds your gear requirements.
Rings/Amulet+Life, Resistances, AttributesKeep resistances climbing as the act penalties begin.
FlasksLife + Mana flasksMaces are slow and stun-hungry; keep both flasks rolling.

Skills & links

How gems & the crossbow swap work in PoE 2. Warrior starts with maces, so Acts 1–2 are played as a melee Slammer (Mace Strike → Rolling Slam → Boneshatter) to use the Strength start. Around level 22 you respec to a Crossbow and switch to Grenades — budget ~7k gold for the refund, so hoard gold until then. Each skill gem starts with 2 support slots; open the 3rd/4th/5th with a Lesser / Greater / Perfect Jeweller's Orb. Supports come from Uncut Support Gems; the T# badge is the tier you need. Grenades are cooldown skills with stored uses — you throw a volley, roll to cancel the wind-up, and the grenades detonate. The build “pops off” at level 33.
Mace StrikeLv 1
Your level-1 melee attack. Cheap, reliable, and benefits from the Warrior Strength start.
Concentrated Area (support)Support T1
More area damage on Mace Strike for tighter, harder hits.
Rage (support)Support T1
Builds Rage as you attack — Rage is a flat 'more' attack-damage stacker you keep all game.
Rolling SlamLv 1
Your main Act-1 damage: a slam that knocks down and clears packs. Add Brink / Rapid Attacks as slots open.
BoneshatterLv ~5
Single-target finisher vs rares — detonates stun build-up. Pair with Impact Shockwave + Magnified Area.
War Banner (Spirit)Spirit
Plant the banner for a damage/Presence aura — a buff you carry from here all the way to endgame.

Levels 13 – 22 — Acts 2–3 — finish the melee phase & 1st ascension

Keep slamming through Acts 2–3 while you build Strength, Life and Armour. Take your first Titan ascendancy point. Keep hoarding gold — you are about to respec the whole tree into Grenades. Don't waste currency on a mace you're about to delete.

Ascendancy this stage: Titan: 1st trial (~lvl 20–25)

Glovesflat Physical / Fire Damage to Attacks, +LifeFlat damage on gloves carries straight into the grenade build.
Belt/Rings+Life, Resistances, StrengthCap resists; Strength meets crossbow/grenade requirements.

Levels 22 – 33 — The Crossbow Swap — Grenades come online

Respec to a Crossbow and switch to Grenades (this is the ~7k-gold refund you saved for). You now throw Explosive Grenade + Flash Grenade + Gas Grenade, using Frost Bomb to expose rares/bosses. Throw grenades ahead of you with long fuses and kite packs into them, or roll to cancel the wind-up so they blow instantly. The build pops off at level 33; replace Frost Bomb with Oil Grenade at 31.

Ascendancy this stage: Titan: Far Shot-equiv / 2nd trial

Gear priorities

SlotItemWhy
WeaponRare Crossbow: %Physical, flat Fire/Phys, Attack Speed (upgrade bases at 16/26/33)Crossbows fire your grenades; high base physical converts to fire.
Gloves/Ringsflat Fire + flat Physical Damage to AttacksFlat attack damage is multiplied by every grenade hit — your best early scaling.
Amulet+to Level of all Skills / Attack Skills, +LifeSkill levels raise the grenade base damage directly.
BootsMovement Speed (mandatory), +Life, ResistancesMovement speed lets you roll-cancel and reposition between volleys.

Levels 33 – 70 — End of Campaign — the full grenade engine

The endgame skeleton comes together. Cluster Grenade replaces Gas Grenade (more grenades + tree cooldown-recovery removes the need for gas), Flash Grenade picks up Armour Break, and Freezing Mark becomes a vessel for Mark for Death (more damage to the marked boss). Eternal Rage keeps Rage permanently full. Add the small area nodes in the grenade cluster ASAP — with Hulking Form every small passive is 50% stronger.

Ascendancy this stage: Titan: 3rd trial — Hulking Form online

Passive tree by this point

Gold = allocated route · gold dots = notables · purple = jewel sockets · faint = unallocated. Rendered from the in-app passive tree (version 0_4); refund/re-path freely as you level.

Levels 71 – 95 — Endgame — links, jewels & weapon swap

Finish the tree, socket three rare jewels, and complete 8 Titan points. Open the 5th support on each grenade with a Perfect Jeweller's Orb. Add Scavenged Plating (stacking Armour) for defence and a Bow + Stormcaller Arrow weapon swap to apply a big Shock (60%+) — swap, shock the boss, swap back to the crossbow. From here it's pure gear optimisation toward the EndGame sheet.

Ascendancy this stage: 8 / 8 — Hulking Form · Crushing Impacts · Mysterious Lineage · Colossal Capacity
